Summary: Canonical relationships read 'none admitted' while the SEC ownership lookup is still pending or has failed, and the VIEW chip is lost after a refresh
Description: 1) Original intent: absence is a classified state, never a silent default (sections 1 and 16); the guest is told whether relationships are none, pending or unchecked. 2) Acceptance criteria: while the SEC ownership lookup for the selected entity is pending the brief and MAP brief say 'Checking SEC ownership filings'; a failed or non-responding lookup (45 s) is stated plainly; 'No canonical relationships admitted' appears only after the lookup settled with none; the lookup retries 3 times before failing; left brief and MAP read the same state. 3) Current implementation state: canonical rho is in memory only (no persistence), so a page refresh empties it and the relationships return only when runTargetedOwnershipObservation (topicconnectors.js, on query submit) completes, seconds later; until then the brief printed the final-sounding 'No canonical relationships admitted' and the VIEW chip was absent; the connector retried once. Reported live (Alphabet 0 bound / 0 admitted run, and 'I lose the view option when I refresh'). 4) Dependencies: topicconnectors.js, secownershipconnector.js, structuralbrief.jsx, structurepanel.jsx; canonical rho persistence is a separate known gap. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none. 6) Maps to current product model: yes. Targeted Gate: new hook useownershiplookup.js shared by both readers; qa_query_corpus 48/48.
